newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ACCI sees Australian growth below three pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ACCI sees Australian growth below three pct.

text.p: The Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (ACCI) said on Wednesday it expected Australia's official economic growth rate to fall below three percent annually in the March quarter.
Australian Bureau of Statistics data released earlier on Wednesday showed seasonally-adjusted GDP rose 0.5 percent in the December quarter for an annual rate of 3.1 percent.

"While the annual growth rate appears reasonable, because of the structure of the quarterly growth movements, GDP will almost certainly fall below three percent when the March quarter figures are released in June," chamber chief executive Mark
Paterson said the national accounts continually overestimated GDP growth during the past year, showing robust growth while other indicators pointed to a flat economy.
"We are now in the midst of the reverse process," he said.
"The economy is starting to gather pace ... while the national accounts show an economy achieving only modest growth."
